Mcp.description: The management operations exposed as MCP tools. Requires the 'OrchardCore.RemoteManagement.Mcp' feature. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/RemoteManagement/.

AllowConfirmationRequiredTools.description: Whether the operations that Pomi asks its users to confirm, such as executing a recipe or deleting a tenant, are exposed as MCP tools.

MaximumResponseBytes.description: The largest response, in bytes, a tool can return. A larger response is turned into a tool error.
